title: Swap Two Ints
hints: Add `std::cout << &a << "\n";` inside `swap_ints` and `std::cout << &x << "\n";` just before the call (needs `#include <iostream>`). Two different addresses means the function is working on a copy of `x`, not on `x`.
Change the parameter types from `int` to `int&`. The body does not need to change at all; `a` and `b` become other names for the caller's variables.
